label: WRONG
reason: Every exported non-function value in hooks/api is a queryKeysFactory-based query-key object named *QueryKeys (api-keys.tsx, promotions.tsx, orders.tsx), and no lint rule in eslint.config.mts or .oxlintrc.json enforces naming, so not TRIVIAL; but the only non-following member, sellers.tsx:257 SELLER_STATUS_LABELS, is a UI label map, a different kind of value that is neither a definition nor the aggregator and can recur, so by R1/R2 it counts as legit (0 of 1 mistakes) and an agent exporting another constant from a hooks file would be told to name it *Keys. Hesitated with ACCEPT since the tool exempts it; wording 'exported values' is also loose because exported const arrow functions (useX, sellerStatusOptions, meQueryOptions) are excluded.
